name: High-bar trend pullback + concentration discipline
thesis: Take 3-15 day swings only in liquid tech names/ETFs that are in an uptrend (above 50d and 200d) and pulling back on no thesis damage. Act once per day at the pre-close batch. Cutting concentration and cap breaches takes priority over new entries.
regimeFit: Risk-on, VIX < 20: entries allowed. Narrative shock in the target group (e.g., AI hardware Oct 8): no entries for ≥ 3 sessions; trims allowed. VIX > 25 or SPY < 200d: exits only.
entryRules: Pullback: 3-8% off the 10-day high with RSI14 between 40 and 55.
No entry within 1 session of CPI/FOMC or the name's earnings; confidence ≥ 0.65.
exitRules: Trim any position above the 25% NAV cap at the next pre-close batch.
Exit on a close below the 50d SMA, or after 15 sessions, or at +10% from entry (half) with a trailing 50d for the rest.
sizingRules: New entries ≤ 15% NAV; hard cap 25% NAV per name.
Max 1 order per day (pre-close only); minimum ticket $5.
riskRules: No bottom-fishing below the 200d (e.g., AVGO after Oct 8).
Count NVDA + SMH + TSM + AVGO together as one AI-hardware bet; combined ≤ 45% NAV.
personaConstraints: PAPER ONLY: no brokerage connection, no real orders.
Every order needs a same-day research record with X, web and market sources, a selected idea, a rationale and a confidence score (enforced by scripts/paper-order.mjs).
Fills: latest Yahoo quote (may lag ~15 min) ± 5 bps slippage; Schwab $0 commission; SEC Section 31 + FINRA TAF on sells.
Minimum ticket $5. Regular market hours only.

history.change: Initial research-driven strategy (replaces the deterministic rule plugin in simEngine.js).
history.reason: The user asked traders to research daily (X, web, SEC, market data) and choose strategies that fit conditions instead of following fixed rules blindly. Rules come from the persona profile plus the Oct 9 pre-market research.
